Arrival & Icebreaker

Employees arrive safelyFirst activity: the icebreakerNew mechanic · not from the source PDFs
1
Two facing lines~200 people: 100 face 100
2
Recognise. Write. Stick.The timer starts. Know the person opposite? Write their name on a sticky note and place it on their forehead.
3
Fastest winsThe other becomes their follower and supporter.
4
Collect your crewRounds continue and followers keep joining their leader. 7 followers close the crew: a crew of 8.
A fast, physical way to break the ice — and see how well people really know each other.
~200 people → ~25 crews of 8Next: The Culture Capsule

The One Island Constitution

25 crewsAll their articles · all their group photos
AIMerges the articles · writes in one voice
One constitutionThe founding document of the island
PrintScreenDigital
Delivery format: to be confirmed with etisalat
From the crews of etisalatSample copy
The One Island Constitution
دستور الجزيرة الواحدة

We, the crews of The One Island, write this together so that everyone who comes after us knows who we are.

Article 1 · Our identity

Everyone here is a founder, not a number.

Article 2 · Who can join

Anyone curious, kind and ready to share the work.

Article 3 · Our red lines

Never leave a colleague behind or hide a mistake.

Article 4 · What we cherish

We cherish people who show up for each other.

Signed by the crews25 crews of etisalat Egypt · Team Building 2026

Volcano Road

Wins: Fuel

The missionSolve riddles together to uncover the answers.
Wins: Clues
Reference: Riddles Safari
Source: Aspire Proposal
The Sea Puzzle Hunt
The missionRetrieve puzzle pieces from the water to complete the bigger picture.
Wins: Pieces

Balanced Wood Challenge
The missionBuild a balanced structure together.
Wins: Materials
Reference: Balanced Wood Challenge

Maze Challenge
The missionMove from the start to the end of the maze together.
Wins: Tools

23Either / or

Build Your Way Across

A
Option A

Build the Boat

Crews use the resources they collected to build boats. The boats carry them to the other island.

Reference: Build the Boat
Source: Final E Teambuilding · Aspire Proposal
or
B
Option B

Build the Bridge

Crews use the resources they collected to build a bridge to reach the other island.

Reference: Bridge
Source: Final E Teambuilding · Aspire Proposal
The final execution chooses one route — never both
